description: This file defines classes and structures related to Open Content Decryption Module (OpenCDM) implementation, including OpenCDMSystem, OpenCDMAccessor, and OpenCDMSession, with methods for session management, secure stop handling, and decryption processes.

classes.name: OpenCDMSystem
classes.description: Represents an OpenCDM system with key system and metadata.

classes.name: OpenCDMAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to OpenCDM sessions and capabilities, managing connection and session creation.

classes.name: OpenCDMSession
classes.description: Manages individual OpenCDM sessions, including decryption, event callbacks, and session lifecycle.

methods.name: CreateSession
methods.description: Creates a new OpenCDM session with specified parameters.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the session object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with the session.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of encrypted data within the session.
